div.head: VII Atr 6.3
div.ab: Et si quis prepositus eam fecerit, duppliciter emendet quod alii iudicaretur.
Et si quis praepositus eam fecerit, duppliciter emendet quod alii iudicaretur.
Et si quis praepositus eam fecerit, dupliciter emendet quod alii iudicaretur.
Und wenn ein Vogt ihn begangen hat, büsse er doppelt, als was einem andern zuerkannt werden würde.
And if a reeve has committed it, let him pay double what would be adjudged against another.
And if any reeve has committed theft, the compensation paid by him shall be double that prescribed to any other person.
And if a reeve has committed theft, he shall make amends at twice the rate imposed upon anyone else.

note.seg: Vgl. Gl Stand 13c; Amtsvergehen 3. a. b; Raub 6
Cf. Gl Stand 13c; Amtsvergehen 3. a. b; Raub 6
Cf. for the doubling of a fine in the case of a reeve, DB. i. 262 b, 1.
